this_worker: Read the frozen/current Stage-1 and Stage-2 manifests, selected nodes, progress ledgers, contracts, and existing receipts.
Recompute and compare local SHA-256 values for the pinned Stage-1 manifest and C1/C3/DC2 node files.
Inspect existing release identities and report their explicit evidence boundaries without upgrading them.
Perform a non-mutating cross-stage gate readback and return BLOCKED/NO-GO when required upstream states are not satisfied.
Write only the protocol-correct return JSON at the declared unique path using apply_patch.

Run database migrations, backfills, seeds, account writes, Feishu writes, email writes, credential mutations, or any other external-system write.

Create or forge missing Stage-1 C1/C3/I9/DC2 or Stage-2 F1/F2/F3 acceptance returns, or reinterpret a VERIFIED candidate receipt as formal acceptance.
Use Stage-2 focused tests, browser fixtures, health, or readiness as a substitute for Stage-1 C1/C3/DC2 formal acceptance.
Assemble or publish a unique Stage-2 candidate before F1, F2, and F3 are formally satisfied.

The Harness SSOT worktree is dirty outside this audit scope and must be handled independently by any future Harness validation.
